scope: Original Unit exit/facing selection and adjacent-cell release/Move destination. The original routines execute; validity inputs and physical placement dependencies are controlled.

observed.score: 128 or -128, minus absolute signed8 heading difference; direction4 loses another100. Strictly greater score wins; best must exceed0.
observed.specialTypeFlag: TechnoType+0xaa0 is IsTrain: INI name0x7f807c, read0x6db041, store0x6db04e; constructor0x6da2dc defaultsfalse. When true, return current rounded facing instead of opposite selected exit.
observed.release: Adjacent cell is the physical Unlimbo point. First pass also requires the cell two steps away and queues that destination. Second pass allows only the near cell and skips offset0; 15 attempts can occur. Failure reinserts the same passenger.
observed.clearNorth: A normal north-facing transport selects southwest and requests northeast. Existing fixed northwest ring output is wrong.

providedDependencies: Private original PE with original entrypoint not executed. Actual direction initialization, Facing.Current, initial selector, list pop/reinsert, mission queue, Unload and RNG execute.
Foot land costs are controlled to1/0 and cells have no occupant objects in this query matrix. Map lookup supplies those actual-shaped cells.

CanEnterCell near/far masks, physical Unlimbo, coordinate adjustment and SetDestination callbacks are provided in the release matrix. Coordinates are cell centers; real infantry subcells are not modeled.
limits: No full original object construction, map occupancy/bridge/cliff collision or user-click frame scheduling claim.
Existing project surface/occupancy admission remains the physical boundary; the new calibrated behavior governs adjacent selection, facing, near/far ordering and a normal admitted departure Move.
Train facing branch is identified and exercised, not a claim to implement train locomotion.
probeCorrections: R1 did not compile because Windows headers define near/far macros; R2 renamed them.

R2 validation incorrectly required every nonzero validity mask to produce an exit and read only the Facing output buffer. R3 accepts original nonpositive-score no-exit and reads the returned DirStruct pointer. Captures and failed logs are preserved.
